turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen's essay. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?
I have until 4:40, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
Nothing is resolved. Write that I asked who decided on the zero, and you haven't answered.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
You need me to say okay so it can be written up as resolved. It isn't. Who entered the zero?
